data.scenario:
On a recent mission, the Avengers were battling several enemies and at a decisive point, Scarlet Witch used her powers to win the fight but put her team at risk and left a lot of collateral damage.
Knowing that, the secret organization known as SHIELD would target her as a possible threat if she did not know how to control her powers.
Because of all this, she would be part of an experiment to be able to control her powers and accompanied by her close friend Black Widow.
The thing is that both girls would find out that the "laboratory" where they would be tested turns out to be a luxurious two-level mansion with several rooms where a great variety of riches and luxuries are displayed.
They will stay there for a year where they will be constantly tested in horny things and wearing ridiculous outfits which only serve to highlight the body of both girls.
